title: Redis Operator / RedisInstance
description: Roles, conditions, Events and replication of a RedisInstance

list.name: Switchover
list.expr: {namespace="redis-operator-system", container="manager"} |~ `\{"name":"$instance","namespace":"$namespace"\}` != `Moved slot` |~ `Started switchover|reason": "Switchover` | regexp `^\S+\t(?P<level>\S+)\t(?:events\t)?(?P<msg>[^\t]+)` | regexp `"reason": "(?P<reason>[^"]+)"` | line_format `operator  {{.msg}} {{.reason}}`

target.expr: {namespace="redis-operator-system", container="manager"} |~ `\{"name":"$instance","namespace":"$namespace"\}` != `Moved slot` |~ `Started switchover|reason": "Switchover` | regexp `^\S+\t(?P<level>\S+)\t(?:events\t)?(?P<msg>[^\t]+)` | regexp `"reason": "(?P<reason>[^"]+)"` | line_format `operator  {{.msg}} {{.reason}}`

list.name: Failover
list.expr: {namespace="redis-operator-system", container="manager"} |~ `\{"name":"$instance","namespace":"$namespace"\}` != `Moved slot` |~ `Started failover|reason": "Failover` | regexp `^\S+\t(?P<level>\S+)\t(?:events\t)?(?P<msg>[^\t]+)` | regexp `"reason": "(?P<reason>[^"]+)"` | line_format `operator  {{.msg}} {{.reason}}`

target.expr: {namespace="redis-operator-system", container="manager"} |~ `\{"name":"$instance","namespace":"$namespace"\}` != `Moved slot` |~ `Started failover|reason": "Failover` | regexp `^\S+\t(?P<level>\S+)\t(?:events\t)?(?P<msg>[^\t]+)` | regexp `"reason": "(?P<reason>[^"]+)"` | line_format `operator  {{.msg}} {{.reason}}`

options.content: **How to read it.** The top row is now. Below, every timeline is one row per Pod or per reason, coloured over time; select a range on any graph with the mouse to replay what happened in it (a switchover, a failover, a rolling update), and read it to the millisecond in *What happened*. Vertical markers on every graph come from the log of the operator: **blue** a switchover, **red** a failover, **purple** a rolling update, **orange** another Event; the switches at the top name them, hover a marker for its text.

panels.title: Primary
panels.description: The Pod in status.currentPrimary: the one -rw sends clients to

panels.title: Primary epoch
panels.description: Grows by one with every switchover and failover

panels.title: Ready instances
panels.description: Ready Pods of status.readyInstances, and spec.instances

panels.title: Ready
panels.description: The condition Ready: green with reason Ready, red with the reason why not

panels.title: Switchovers
panels.description: Planned moves of the primary of this instance in the time range

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="redis-operator-system", container="manager"} |~ `\{"name":"$instance","namespace":"$namespace"\}` |~ `Completed (switchover|failover)` | regexp `\t(?P<fields>\{.*\})$` | line_format `{{.fields}}` | json kind | drop fields |= `"kind": "switchover"` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failovers
panels.description: Failovers of this instance in the time range

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="redis-operator-system", container="manager"} |~ `\{"name":"$instance","namespace":"$namespace"\}` |~ `Completed (switchover|failover)` | regexp `\t(?P<fields>\{.*\})$` | line_format `{{.fields}}` | json kind | drop fields |= `"kind": "failover"` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Slowest switchover
panels.description: From the start of the switchover until the target is the primary

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({namespace="redis-operator-system", container="manager"} |~ `\{"name":"$instance","namespace":"$namespace"\}` |~ `Completed (switchover|failover)` | regexp `\t(?P<fields>\{.*\})$` | line_format `{{.fields}}` | json kind, durationMs | drop fields |= `"kind": "switchover"` | unwrap durationMs [$__range]))

panels.title: Slowest failover
panels.description: From the start of the failover until the target is the primary

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({namespace="redis-operator-system", container="manager"} |~ `\{"name":"$instance","namespace":"$namespace"\}` |~ `Completed (switchover|failover)` | regexp `\t(?P<fields>\{.*\})$` | line_format `{{.fields}}` | json kind, durationMs | drop fields |= `"kind": "failover"` | unwrap durationMs [$__range]))

panels.title: Longest primary outage
panels.description: How long the primary was unavailable before a failover ended: failover.delay and the failover

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({namespace="redis-operator-system", container="manager"} |~ `\{"name":"$instance","namespace":"$namespace"\}` |~ `Completed (switchover|failover)` | regexp `\t(?P<fields>\{.*\})$` | line_format `{{.fields}}` | json kind, downMs | drop fields |= `"kind": "failover"` | unwrap downMs [$__range]))

panels.title: Every switchover and failover
panels.description: One row per switchover or failover, from the line the operator logs when it ends. Took: from its start to the new primary. Primary down: for a failover, since the old primary became unavailable.

targets.expr: {namespace="redis-operator-system", container="manager"} |~ `\{"name":"$instance","namespace":"$namespace"\}` |~ `Completed (switchover|failover)` | regexp `\t(?P<fields>\{.*\})$` | line_format `{{.fields}}` | json kind, name, from, to, epoch, durationMs, downMs | drop fields

panels.title: How long each one took
panels.description: A point per switchover (blue) and failover (red) at the moment it ended; the height is how long it took (log scale)

targets.expr: max by (kind) (max_over_time({namespace="redis-operator-system", container="manager"} |~ `\{"name":"$instance","namespace":"$namespace"\}` |~ `Completed (switchover|failover)` | regexp `\t(?P<fields>\{.*\})$` | line_format `{{.fields}}` | json kind, durationMs | drop fields | unwrap durationMs [$__interval]))

panels.title: What happened, to the millisecond
panels.description: The log of the operator about this instance and the logs of its Pods (Redis, the Instance Manager, the exporter), in order. Select the time of a switchover or failover on a graph to read it step by step: the fence, the promotion, REPLICAOF, the partial resync.

panels.title: Role of every Pod
panels.description: Green: the primary. Orange: the replica the operator is promoting (status.targetPrimary). The green bar jumping rows is a switchover or a failover.

panels.title: Pod Ready (kubelet)
panels.description: Red while a Pod restarts, or a replica has not finished its first sync

panels.title: Conditions: one row each, the text is the reason
panels.description: Every condition of the RedisInstance on one row; the bar shows its reason over time. Green: fine (Ready, Applied, Issued). Grey: idle (Completed). Orange: something runs (InProgress, RollingUpdate, Switchover). Red: a problem (PrimaryUnavailable, Failed, ...).

panels.title: Replication: who replicates from whom, and where it runs
panels.description: Every Pod with the machine it runs on and its commands per second (green the primary, blue a replica); every arrow a replica, with the bytes per second it replicates.

targets.expr: sum by (id, title, subtitle, color) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (pod, node, role) ((rate(redis_commands_processed_total{namespace="$namespace",redis_instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and redis_commands_processed_total{namespace="$namespace",redis_instance="$instance"}) * on (pod) group_left (node) max by (pod, pod_ip, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace",pod=~"$instance-[0-9]+"})), "id", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "subtitle", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "color", "green", "role", "primary"), "color", "blue", "role", "replica"))

sum by (id, source, target) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (pod, slave_ip) (deriv(redis_connected_slave_offset_bytes{namespace="$namespace",redis_instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and redis_connected_slave_offset_bytes{namespace="$namespace",redis_instance="$instance"}) * on (slave_ip) group_left (replica) label_replace(label_replace(max by (pod, pod_ip, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace",pod=~"$instance-[0-9]+"}), "replica", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "slave_ip", "$1", "pod_ip", "(.*)"), "source", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "target", "$1", "replica", "(.*)"), "id", "->", "source", "target"))

panels.title: Replication throughput per replica
panels.description: Bytes per second each replica takes from its primary: the write traffic of the primary

targets.expr: sum by (pod, slave_ip) ((deriv(redis_connected_slave_offset_bytes{namespace="$namespace",redis_instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (pod, slave_ip) redis_connected_slave_offset_bytes{namespace="$namespace",redis_instance="$instance"}) * on (slave_ip) group_left (replica) label_replace(label_replace(max by (pod, pod_ip, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace",pod=~"$instance-[0-9]+"}), "replica", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "slave_ip", "$1", "pod_ip", "(.*)")

panels.title: Lag of every replica
panels.description: The most bytes of writes the replica had not acknowledged in each minute, as its primary sees it. A replica acknowledges once a second, so up to a second of writes is normal; a line that keeps growing is a replica that falls behind.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, slave_ip) ((max_over_time((max by (pod) (redis_master_repl_offset{namespace="$namespace",redis_instance="$instance"}) - on (pod) group_right redis_connected_slave_offset_bytes{namespace="$namespace",redis_instance="$instance"})[1m:])) and on (pod, slave_ip) redis_connected_slave_offset_bytes{namespace="$namespace",redis_instance="$instance"}) * on (slave_ip) group_left (replica) label_replace(label_replace(max by (pod, pod_ip, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="$namespace",pod=~"$instance-[0-9]+"}), "replica", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "slave_ip", "$1", "pod_ip", "(.*)")

panels.title: Resyncs served in the time range
panels.description: Full: the primary sent a whole snapshot (a new or a lost replica). Partial: a replica caught up from the backlog, e.g. after a switchover.

panels.title: Commands per second
panels.description: A dip on the primary is the pause of a switchover or the gap of a failover

panels.title: Keys
panels.description: Equal on every Pod once the replicas are in sync

panels.title: Volumes used
panels.description: Used space of every PVC, from the kubelet; orange from 70 %, red from 85 %

panels.title: AOF size
panels.description: The append-only file grows with every write and shrinks at a rewrite

panels.title: Since the last RDB save
panels.description: How old the snapshot on the volume is; with persistence aof the AOF has the writes since

panels.title: State of every volume
panels.description: status.volumes: a new row appears when a volume becomes Terminating, Missing or Lost

targets.expr: max by (ordinal, state) (redis_operator_instance_volume{namespace="$namespace",redis_instance="$instance"}) or (max by (ordinal, state) (max_over_time(redis_operator_instance_volume{namespace="$namespace",redis_instance="$instance"}[$__range])) * 0 - 1)
